/            Filter Mode
?            Help
Ctrl-S       Save
Ctrl-Space   Mark Range
Ctrl-W       Toggle Wide
Ctrl-Z       Toggle Faults
Ctrl-\       Marks Clear
Enter        Filter
Esc          Filter Reset
Shift-A      Sort Age
Shift-J      Jump Owner
Shift-N      Sort Name
Shift-O      Sort Selected Column
Shift-R      Reconcile
Shift-S      Sort Status
Shift-T      Suspend/Resume [dangerous]
Shift-W      Reconcile w/ Source
Shift-Z      Jump Source
key-272      Help
q            Filter Reset
space        Mark
